dct_description_sm: This project compared liquid, soluble granule and granular formulations of Fiesta at varying rates on pre-emergent and post-emergent control of crabgrass and other weeds in a cultivated area of soil. Two industry standard treatments were also included. The study has provided information on product efficacy.
